name: task-queue
description: Async task queue with concurrency control, priority ordering, pause/resume, and completion callbacks.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to run async tasks with a concurrency limit (e.g. limit parallel API calls to 3 at a time). Supports priority-based ordering, pause/resume for flow control, clearing pending tasks, and an onDone callback for when the queue is empty.

parameters.name: concurrency
parameters.description: Maximum number of tasks to run in parallel at once. Defaults to 1.
